name: Stalwart
description: Play the Stalwart if you want to take heavy blows and keep fighting.

foundation.name: Unwavering
foundation.text: Gain a permanent +1 bonus to your damage thresholds.

foundation.name: Iron Will
foundation.text: When you take physical damage, you can mark an additional Armor Slot to reduce the severity.

specialization.name: Unrelenting
specialization.text: Gain a permanent +2 bonus to your damage thresholds.

specialization.name: Partners-in-Arms
specialization.text: When an ally within Very Close range takes damage, you can mark an Armor Slot to reduce the severity by one threshold.

mastery.name: Undaunted
mastery.text: Gain a permanent +3 bonus to your damage thresholds.

mastery.name: Loyal Protector
mastery.text: When an ally within Close range has 2 or fewer Hit Points and would take damage, you can mark a Stress to sprint to their side and take the damage instead.
